# Supplemental third-party notices

The installed DSH Molecular Viewer includes the Mol* runtime from OpenAI's
Codex Molecular Structure Viewer 0.1.96. The original dependency inventory
and license texts are in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

## Mediabunny 1.44.2

The viewer's compiled JavaScript contains Mediabunny 1.44.2. Mediabunny
Source Code Form is available under the Mozilla Public License, version 2.0.
Download the release archive below and extract `package/src/` for the
TypeScript source and `package/LICENSE` for its license. The release and
source are available without charge.

- [Mediabunny 1.44.2 archive with source](https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.44.2.tgz)
- [Upstream release source tree](https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/067081d5ebe6f73e8938005f8b237cd1901fe73d)
- [Mozilla Public License 2.0](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/MPL/2.0/)

The DSH changes affect the enclosing viewer integration and export labels.
